rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a clear loss of momentum after the initial gap-up surge — price spiked to $25.89 and has since stepped down to $25.57, with each successive close lower and volume declining sharply from 120K to 35K. The wide bid-ask spread of ~74 bps creates an immediate structural headwind, and with price sitting 71% through today's range after a 4.75% gap, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear: chasing the long risks buying exhaustion near the high, while shorting a strong gap-up with elevated relative volume (5.39x) on a loan-broker name carries squeeze risk. The current consolidation lacks a clean directional signal to justify committing capital.
